 Election Day is almost here and voters are letting their voices be heard.
 As of Thursday, 47,101 people had cast ballots in Guadalupe County. The county currently has 142,968 registered voters, but those early voting numbers represent about 32.94%. Friday’s numbers were not available as of press time.
